name: approval_policy
description: Control when Codex pauses for approval before executing commands; granular policy objects can handle prompt categories separately.

examples.explanation: Let Codex request approval when an operation needs escalation.

when_to_use: Use in config.toml to set a persistent approval default instead of passing --ask-for-approval each time.

conditions: Managed requirements can restrict allowed values.

notes: The on-failure value is deprecated; official guidance is on-request for interactive runs or never for non-interactive runs.

name: sandbox_mode
description: Select the persistent sandbox policy applied to tool execution unless an invocation overrides it.

examples.explanation: Allow workspace writes while keeping host access sandboxed by default.

when_to_use: Use to establish the normal isolation boundary for Codex work.
when_not_to_use: Do not select danger-full-access as a convenience default on a normal workstation.

conditions: Managed requirements can restrict allowed sandbox modes.

name: model_reasoning_effort
description: Set the default reasoning effort requested from supported Codex models.

examples.explanation: Use high reasoning effort as the default for new work.

when_to_use: Use when most sessions benefit from a consistent supported effort level.
when_not_to_use: Use a -c override when only one invocation needs a different effort.

conditions: Supported values depend on the selected model.
